description: This file contains integration tests for subscription-related functionalities in the Focalboard server, including creating, retrieving, and deleting subscriptions.

methods.name: createTestSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test subscriptions for a user, including creating a board, blocks, and subscriptions.

methods.name: TestCreateSubscription
methods.description: Tests the creation of valid and invalid subscriptions.

methods.name: TestGetSubscriptions
methods.description: Tests retrieving subscriptions for a user, ensuring only the current user's subscriptions are returned.

methods.name: TestDeleteSubscription
methods.description: Tests deleting a subscription and handling deletion of non-existent subscriptions.
